contractSeams.relation: Durable Registry CAS owns the transition from Accepted into the one-Attempt physical dispatch boundary.
Runtime routes only dispatch-eligible Attempts toward realization and reconciles already-dispatched states instead of blind redispatch.

The production Runtime dispatch seam crosses the durable dispatch boundary into the committed provider realization path; Linux/Windows mechanism internals may move without changing this named owner seam.

supportScope: machine-checkable currentness of the named TLA+ model, Runtime invariant references, stable Runtime contract seams and proving-test identities
bounded correspondence for the at-most-once physical dispatch and ambiguity-preserving design seams
provider refactors may move Linux or Windows realization internals without invalidating the trace while the ExecutionProvider.realize contract seam remains current
fairness-qualified abstract first-decision progress: admitted work reaches terminal evidence or explicit ambiguity, not guaranteed eventual completion

Always-on Registry CAS/held-orphan native tests are bounded implementation witnesses; ignored physical integration tests are conditional, unexecuted by normal CI and cannot establish production realization.

TLC bounded terminal-state provenance: terminal Job implies committed reconciliation on its dispatched Attempt; existing Rust owner test separately checks more detailed evidence fields; no mechanized refinement is claimed
bounded pairwise state safety: the lost predecessor and a new admitted retry are distinct, while an unresolved live predecessor cannot overlap a live retry

always-on native concurrent same-request admission test witnesses one Job/Attempt and one reserved slot under two racing submitters; bounded initial-admission slice only, not a whole Rust-to-model refinement
bounded identity consistency: every abstract live Attempt is the current Attempt before a second retry could introduce overlap
abstract held-orphan fence: Runtime may clear the selected Attempt while preserving a reserved orphan that remains recovery-required; no blind retry
held-orphan reservation is a separate BOOLEAN owner abstraction; a qualifying orphan may arise before or after confirmed dispatch
nonClaims: This is not a mechanized refinement proof from Rust semantics to TLA+ semantics.
Passing this gate does not prove all Runtime implementations or all environmental behaviors conform to the model.
The finite TLC model remains abstraction evidence and must be checked separately.
The integration tests remain empirical implementation evidence and may require an owner-native real-system environment.
This trace does not establish domain semantic completion or exactly-once external effects.
Weak fairness is a model assumption; real scheduling, provider responsiveness, retries, deadlock freedom and domain completion are not proven.
Conditional physical acceptance test identity does not prove that a root/systemd/cgroup test was executed or passed.
The new NoCompetingLiveAttempts abstract invariant is model-checked but not an always-on Rust proof: physical concurrent-observer and ambiguity-no-redrive integration tests are opt-in.
NoDetachedLiveAttempt does not prove Rust/SQLite refinement; admission and held-orphan Rust witnesses are narrower concrete cases.
The abstract orphanedHeld state is only a bounded projection of a persisted held-orphan reservation. It does not establish persistence/recovery refinement or cross-Job reservation exclusivity.
The heldReservation Boolean abstracts one Job only; it does not prove global capacity accounting or physical launch occurrence for an Orphaned attempt.

supportingContracts.relation: The provider SPI names the replaceable realization obligation; it is supporting contract evidence rather than a claim that every current production provider is dynamically dispatched through this trait.
